title: Vector gun
subtitle: Operating modes
noGun: The party does not have the gun.

mana.name: Mana bullets
mana.effect: Attack damage uses INT instead of the weapon's own scaling.

recoil.name: Vector recoil
recoil.effect: Targets hit are knocked back and floated.

solomonIncantation.name: Solomon incantation
solomonIncantation.desc: Spells log a line of their chant. Full chant with the grimoire open.
solomonIncantation.effect: Spells cast with the vector gun add a random chant line to the battle log. With the Grimoire of Solomon fitted, or open in Graceful Death, the full chant is logged and the spell deals or heals 15% more.

card.name: Card
card.effect: A killing blow adds that enemy's monster card to the collection.

wide.name: Wide shots
wide.desc: Hits several body parts for less damage.
wide.effect: Lower total damage, split across several body parts per attack.

psi.name: Psi vectors
psi.effect: Attack damage uses PSI instead of the weapon's own scaling.

burst.name: Burst fire
burst.desc: Two shots per attack at 70% damage.
burst.effect: Each attack fires twice at 70% damage.

drain.name: Vampiric vectors
drain.effect: The user recovers HP equal to 25% of damage dealt.

siphon.name: Mana siphon
siphon.effect: The user recovers MP equal to 15% of damage dealt.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.effect: Critical hit chance increases by 40 points.

overload.name: Overload
overload.effect: The coilgun's rack of shots is doubled. All shots deal 85% damage.

hex.name: Hexed rounds
hex.effect: A hit has a 40% chance to inflict one of: blind, silence, unbalance, vulnerability, broken guard.

longshot.name: Long shot
longshot.effect: Doubles weapon range on the battle map, in any ranged form.

venom.name: Venom rounds
venom.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict poison.

concussion.name: Concussive rounds
concussion.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict stun.

thermalOverload.name: Thermal overload
thermalOverload.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict burning.

thermalUnderload.name: Thermal underload
thermalUnderload.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict freeze.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: More damage to low HP targets.
executioner.effect: Damage rises as target HP falls, up to +60% against a target near death.

ambush.name: Ambush protocol
ambush.effect: Attacks made in the first turn of a battle deal 150% damage.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.effect: Damage rises with the user's current MP, up to +40% at full MP.

overpressure.name: Overpressure
overpressure.desc: 135% damage, 2 coilgun shots per round fired.
overpressure.effect: Each shot deals 135% damage and counts as 2 of the coilgun's shots.

hollowPoint.name: Hollow point
hollowPoint.effect: Critical hits deal 75% more damage. Does not change critical rate.

deepMagazine.name: Deep magazine
deepMagazine.effect: The coilgun holds 4 more shots before it folds back. Damage unchanged.

toast.unracked: Coilgun spent, folded back into the pistol.
toast.spent: {form} spent, folded back into the pistol.
toast.natural: Dice of Yaldabaoth: natural {n}. The Grimoire of Solomon opens.

locked.equip: Only Em can equip the vector gun.
locked.part: The vector gun cannot leave Em.

element.title: Element
element.hint: Applies to the pistol only. Weapon forms have no element. The coilgun's element is set in Calibration.

desc.2: Fire damage, can set the target burning.
desc.3: Ice damage, can freeze the target.
desc.8: Holy damage, extra effective against undead.

form.gunGain: Uses the element and up to 3 modes.
form.diceGain: The pistol keeps the element and modes until the roll.

dice.name: Dice of Yaldabaoth
dice.desc: Rolls a d20 for the form.
dice.effect: SWITCH rolls a d20 and turns into that face's form, locked or not. 1: Fists of Em. 20: Grimoire of Solomon, no HP cost. SWITCH again returns to the pistol.

gun.name: Coilgun of Tesla
gun.effect: SWITCH: coilgun, 3 shots, 4x range. Back to the pistol after the third shot.

abrasax.name: Athame of Abrasax
abrasax.effect: Hits can inflict the chosen status. Stronger statuses have lower odds. PSI raises the odds.

thelema.name: Blade of Thelema
thelema.effect: Normal attacks can become the chosen sword skill, paying its AP. The skill does not need to be learned.

babalon.name: Axe of Babalon
babalon.effect: Hits the chosen number of targets. More targets, less damage each.

nuit.name: Scourge of Nuit
nuit.effect: Hits lower the chosen stat. Less damage.

hadit.name: Staff of Hadit
hadit.effect: Switching to it sets the chosen weather. No effect indoors.

aiwass.name: Bow of Aiwass
aiwass.effect: Longer draw: more range, less damage.

baphomet.name: Talons of Baphomet
baphomet.effect: Hits drain the chosen resource. Draining AP costs the most.

kia.name: Gauntlet of Kia
kia.effect: Grants the chosen stance while equipped. Lowers damage dealt.

sniper.name: Coilgun
sniper.effect: 3 shots, 4x range. The last shot reverts it to the pistol.

solomon.name: Grimoire of Solomon
solomon.effect: Battles start with the grimoire open, as a permanent Graceful Death with no costs or limits. Graceful Death deals the strongest spells of the calibrated schools. Normal attacks reach 4 tiles.

fists.name: Fists of Em
fists.effect: Normal attacks can become one of the chosen martial arts skills, paying its AP.

eris.name: Nunchaku of Eris
eris.effect: Wider spread: higher average damage, less consistent.

maat.name: Mail of Maat
maat.effect: More damage the more the target's chosen stat is out of balance. Less damage to balanced targets.

bubba.name: Wrench of Bubba
bubba.effect: Much more damage to the chosen creature type, less to others.

yaldabaoth.name: Chainsaw of YHWH
yaldabaoth.effect: More damage the more hurt the target is, by the chosen reading. Less damage to unhurt targets.

nyarlathotep.name: Scythe of Nyarlathotep
nyarlathotep.effect: Critical hits have a 50% chance to kill outright, on the chosen side. Never Em, bosses, petrodemons or anything over 10 levels above her.

freud.name: Katana of Freud
freud.effect: Damage scales on PSI. Normal attacks can become the chosen psychic skill, paying its AP.

gautama.name: Rosary of Gautama
gautama.effect: No damage. Attacks heal allies. Choose what it heals.

lash.desc: Lowers this parameter on hit for a few rounds. 45% chance, 85% damage.

Blunt.name: Blunt
Blunt.desc: Blunt damage. Effective against bones and armour.

Cutting.name: Cutting
Cutting.desc: Cutting damage. Effective against flesh and soft targets.

Piercing.name: Piercing
Piercing.desc: Piercing damage. Effective against joints and weak points.

Explosive.name: Explosive
Explosive.desc: Explosive damage. Spread across every body part.

double.name: Two
double.desc: Hits two targets at 72% damage each.

triple.name: Three
triple.desc: Hits three targets at 50% damage each.

reach.name: Held out
reach.desc: Range 4 tiles instead of 2. Normal damage.

health.name: Their wounds
health.desc: More damage the lower the target's HP.

mana.name: Their reservoir
mana.desc: More damage the lower the target's MP.

states.name: What they carry
states.desc: More damage for every state on the target.

level.name: The gap between you
level.desc: More damage the bigger the level gap, in either direction.

wound.name: The wound
wound.desc: More damage the more overall damage the target's body has taken.

ruin.name: The ruin
ruin.desc: More damage the worse the target's most damaged part is.

tally.name: The tally
tally.desc: More damage for every body part the target has lost.

patron.name: Patron
patron.desc: 20% chance to reap an enemy on a critical hit. Normal damage.

tithe.name: Tithe
tithe.desc: 50% chance to reap an ally on a critical hit. 130% damage.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.desc: 50% chance to reap anyone on a critical hit. 110% damage.

state.name: An affliction
state.desc: Removes one state from the target.

party.name: All of them
party.desc: Restores a smaller amount of HP to the whole party.

22.desc: Counter Attack: strikes back when hit.

55.desc: Combo: attacks chain into extra hits.

gun.hint: The coilgun has its own element. A doubled rack doubles the ammo cost per shot.

abrasax.hint: Applies one status. Harsher ones land less often. PSI raises the odds.

thelema.hint: Normal attacks may become this sword skill, paying its AP. No need to learn it.

freud.hint: Damage scales on PSI. Normal attacks may become this skill, paying its AP.

fists.hint: Normal attacks may become a random skill from the set, paying its AP.

kia.hint: Active while the gauntlet is equipped. Lowers your damage.

hadit.hint: Switching to the staff sets this weather. Affects enemies too. No effect indoors.

solomon.hint: Spells come from the selected schools, or all schools if none. Too narrow a pick may leave nothing.

choronzon.hint: Decides what the attack is strong and weak against.

babalon.hint: Number of targets. Each extra target lowers damage to all.

nuit.hint: Lowers one stat on hit, for less damage.

aiwass.hint: Longer draw: more range, less damage.

baphomet.hint: What the talons drain. Draining AP costs the most.

longinus.hint: Attack style. Each one has a trade-off.

eris.hint: Wider variance: higher average damage, less predictable hits.

maat.hint: The stat the target is weighed on. Balanced targets take less than a normal attack.

bubba.hint: Much more damage to this target type, less to others.

yaldabaoth.hint: What the bar measures. Unhurt targets take less than a normal attack.

nyarlathotep.hint: Which side can be reaped. Never Em, bosses, petrodemons or anything 10+ levels above her.

gautama.hint: What the rosary heals. Deals no damage.
